visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all 13 final portable views and six contact sheets containing all 51 final renders. Compared with eight full local originals, all 35 reference contact views, native component plans and primary NPS/CTBUH/restoration records. Warm yellow stucco, pale concrete trim, three-column shaft windows with true recesses, bracketed cornices and corner quoins. Raised east entrance has original closed oak door panels, glazed semicircular fanlight, paired columns, broken scrolled pediment, simplified cartouche/figures, iron balcony and glazed quatrefoils. Plain attached west printing wing has divided windows and a stepped central pitched gable. Crown includes four open corner turrets, decorated square stage, open balustrades, tall octagonal lantern, green paneled copper dome, open beacon and ship vane. Repaired downward roof normals, unsupported crown/lantern gaps, blocked crown arch heads/oculi, and entrance/window horizontal misalignment before final captures.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Actually inspected all 13 current shared-material views, including the own native footprint placement. Seven authored material groups; four shared plaster, plain concrete, painted metal and copper identities. Pale plain concrete replaces overly rough weathered limestone on cast-concrete ornament. Green-grey opaque glazing and oak panels use authored vertex colors, without photographic textures or baked night lighting. Open lanterns, turrets, grilles and balconies retain actual negative space. Synthetic library ground exposes the buried foundation; independent terrain is verified separately.

mediumFiReview.notes: Actually inspected all 25 current version-2 lighting, quality, silhouette, detail and forced-level views. Canonical Freedom Tower Miami asset and selected LOD identities verified in every frame. Explicit 949/3571/15865/48481 triangle levels satisfy the four budgets. Skyline preserves attached printing wing, tower rhythm, crown stages, actual open upper lantern and vane. District restores the major entrance, windows and crown silhouettes. Street restores recessed windows, real crown/turret openings, six entrance risers, portal/fanlight and divided glazing. Close restores dense brackets, balusters, window bars, layered portal/cartouches, niche borders, copper panels and geometric ship vane. Seven draw calls near, six district, one skyline. Error bounds are authoring estimates, not scan-derived measurements.

geographicReview.notes: Own native historic tower, base, crown components and directly attached west printing wing only. Anchor and heading match the source map; +X is almost north along the frontage and +Z faces the east entrance/Biscayne Boulevard. Original irregular base remains direct; shaft and square-crown facade planes use rectangular bounds with measured corner-to-native-edge deviations recorded above. Historic NPS 125ft frontage and 253/189ft property lines describe the parcel, not the building footprint. CTBUH nominal 86.3m overall/64.9m highest occupied and NPS restored 19ft vane control the interpreted heights; Qualla 255ft/native 84.5m and 83m values disagree and remain documented. Four original Terrarium tiles were acquired before geometry; all 4225 independent grid samples, original SHAs, dry eastern datum and PNG16 round trip verify. Ground was neither flattened nor fitted. Buried -4m foundation closes the actual sampled perimeter. Six nominal 0.1524m risers reach the historic approximately 3ft raised entrance; all 12 near-level tread rays and their independent ground clearances pass. Bounded preview, footprint replacement disabled. Urban DEM and threshold engineering remain approximate.

fidelityReview.scope: Historic Mediterranean tower and printing wing: yellow stucco, scrolled portal/quatrefoils, corner turrets, open lantern, copper dome/ship vane.
fidelityReview.notes: The cleared uncropped Marc Averette exterior confirms the yellow rectangular tower above a broad low base, repeated dark window grid, pale highly articulated crown and green lantern cap. The current silhouette and mapped base match. Fine crown sculpture, rear fenestration and exact restoration state remain approximate. Accepted at the agreed approximate medium-fi exterior scope. No reference pixels are embedded. Previously used attribution/private imagery is excluded from this current review.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four authored Float32 meshes and actual imported runtime meshes validate their normals, winding, finite coordinates and colors. All 48 authored roof triangles point upward. 710 actual-runtime checks pass: 216 shaft recess rays and 216 opaque glazing closures, base window/quatrefoil/fanlight recesses, actual turret/lantern/oculus/beacon openings, crown arch heads and support plinths, pierced balconies/grilles, roofs, six entrance treads and independent ground clearances, and own native perimeter closures. Far levels deliberately simplify facade recesses and fine ornament while preserving the structural silhouette and upper negative spaces.
